reading.body:
Tome is an AI storytelling and presentation generation product, and its only listed integration is an MCP server for customer segmentation and sales targeting.

The product note covers presentation generation, narrative design, and creative IP, while the MCP tool analyzes customer data to predict which customers to focus on for more sales. That pairing suggests a presentation company extending into customer intelligence, but the entry gives no scale, usage, or model details.

This data contains no compute, building, or power figures, so it cannot support any claim about grid constraints or AI scaling. It records one product and one integration, nothing more.
